scope: Eight base room plates plus four spent/depleted state variants. No application code or runtime collision validation.
base_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one actual 2D game room background plate for an original cartoon underground mining social-strategy game. Create a square 1024x1024 image, full opaque canvas, viewed orthographically from directly above with very short visible inner wall faces, like a readable 2D cutaway game map. NOT a diamond/isometric room, NOT a perspective scene. Thick smooth charcoal outlines, simple flat cel-shaded shapes, broad low-detail surfaces readable on a phone. Graphite and muted violet rock perimeter with warm slate/sand stone floor. One room fills the square: walls in the outer 16 percent, broad traversable central floor. Exactly four open rectangular passage ports, centered north/east/south/west at the middle of each image edge; each passage spans approximately 20 percent of its edge. Keep floor in a clear plus-shaped route connecting all four passage ports, with clear central square from 30 to70 percent x/y. Props tucked into corner/perimeter alcoves, never across these routes. All rooms in this pack should share this camera, footprint, centered passage positions and scale. No people, characters, names, labels, arrows, text, UI, game logos, watermark, floating icons or exterior background. No glowing doorway or surface exit clue; any safe-room glow comes only from peripheral minerals. This is artwork only, not a collision diagram.
